title: Pueblo, CO — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Pueblo, CO: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Pueblo is a city in CO with a population of 112,000. Steel City on the Arkansas River with historic architecture and affordable living. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
